The bench room can't be entered before day 3. The Gold Key appears morning of day 3. It's currently Day 1, 7:12. I need to wait until day 3 morning.

Let me first gather the materials I can reach (Wood at (4,6) already got, Wood at (2,2), and check what's reachable). Actually, I need 3 Wood and 2 Stone. The Stone at (9,8) and (10,1) are behind the door. Let me check which materials are on my side.

Left side (x=0..7): Wood at (4,6) ✓, Wood at (2,2). Stone? The stones are at (9,8) and (10,1) — both on the right side. So I can't get stone until day 3.

Let me gather the reachable wood now, then wait until day 3.
